items.item: The visibility map stores one bit per heap page saying whether every row on it is visible to all current and future transactions

at.step: Reveal: this only works because of the visibility map

items.item: An index-only scan checks the visibility map bit; if unset, it must visit the heap anyway, gaining no advantage

at.step: Reveal: this only works because of the visibility map

items.item: INCLUDE columns let a covering index answer a query's full column needs without a table visit

at.step: Reveal: INCLUDE columns and index-only scans

items.item: A partial index indexes only rows satisfying a predicate; indexing a common value is pointless since queries for it won't use the index anyway

at.step: Reveal: partial indexes over a hot subset

items.item: An index column can be a function or expression computed from the table's own columns
